title: Locust Wood Capital Advisers LLC Has $52.30 Million Position in Apple (AAPL)
text:
Locust Wood Capital Advisers LLC increased its holdings in Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 59.5% in the fourth quarter, according to its most recent filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The firm owned 309,021 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after purchasing an additional 115,230 shares during the quarter. Apple accounts for about 4.8% of Locust Wood Capital Advisers LLC’s holdings, making the stock its 5th largest holding. Locust Wood Capital Advisers LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $52,296,000 as of its most recent SEC filing.
Several other hedge funds also recently bought and sold shares of the company. Oak Point Wealth Management purchased a new position in Apple in the fourth quarter worth approximately $163,000. Interactive Financial Advisors purchased a new position in Apple in the fourth quarter worth approximately $188,000. Financial & Investment Management Group Ltd. purchased a new position in Apple in the fourth quarter worth approximately $204,000. Home Federal Bank of Tennessee purchased a new position in Apple in the fourth quarter worth approximately $217,000. Finally, Paragon Wealth Strategies LLC purchased a new position in Apple in the fourth quarter worth approximately $222,000. Institutional investors and hedge funds own 61.12% of the company’s stock. In other news, insider Luca Maestri sold 39,122 shares of Apple stock in a transaction that occurred on Friday, April 13th. The shares were sold at an average price of $174.66, for a total transaction of $6,833,048.52. Following the completion of the sale, the insider now directly owns 64,475 shares in the company, valued at approximately $11,261,203.50. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the SEC, which is available through this hyperlink . Also, insider Philip W. Schiller sold 69,491 shares of Apple stock in a transaction that occurred on Tuesday, April 3rd. The shares were sold at an average price of $166.42, for a total transaction of $11,564,692.22. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Over the last quarter, insiders have sold 125,988 shares of company stock valued at $21,336,201. Insiders own 0.06% of the company’s stock. Shares of NASDAQ:AAPL opened at $183.83 on Monday. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.80, a current ratio of 1.46 and a quick ratio of 1.37. The stock has a market capitalization of $932,755.88, a P/E ratio of 19.96, a PEG ratio of 1.37 and a beta of 1.26. Apple has a 52 week low of $142.20 and a 52 week high of $184.25.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings data on Tuesday, May 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.73 EPS for the quarter, beating the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $2.69 by $0.04. The firm had revenue of $61.14 billion during the quarter, compared to the consensus estimate of $60.94 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.55% and a return on equity of 39.97%. The firm’s revenue was up 15.6% compared to the same quarter last year. During the same quarter last year, the firm earned $2.10 earnings per share. sell-side analysts anticipate that Apple will post 11.43 earnings per share for the current fiscal year.
Apple announced that its board has initiated a share buyback plan on Tuesday, May 1st that authorizes the company to buyback $100.00 billion in shares. This buyback authorization authorizes the iPhone maker to repurchase up to 11.9% of its stock through open market purchases. Stock buyback plans are generally an indication that the company’s management believes its shares are undervalued.
The business also recently declared a quarterly dividend, which will be paid on Thursday, May 17th. Stockholders of record on Monday, May 14th will be given a dividend of $0.73 per share. This represents a $2.92 dividend on an annualized basis and a dividend yield of 1.59%. This is an increase from Apple’s previous quarterly dividend of $0.63. The ex-dividend date of this dividend is Friday, May 11th. Apple’s dividend payout ratio (DPR) is presently 27.36%.
AAPL has been the subject of several analyst reports. Macquarie set a $188.00 price objective on Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research report on Friday, January 26th. Barclays lowered their price objective on Apple from $170.00 to $168.00 and set an “equal weight” rating for the company in a research report on Friday, March 16th. Zacks Investment Research upgraded Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $197.00 price target on the stock in a research note on Thursday, January 18th. Bank of America cut Apple from a “buy” rating to a “neutral” rating and upped their price target for the stock from $180.00 to $220.00 in a research note on Wednesday, January 17th. Finally, Maxim Group upped their price target on Apple from $204.00 to $210.00 and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a research note on Friday, February 2nd. One research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, seventeen have given a hold rating, thirty-three have given a buy rating and two have given a strong buy rating to the stock. The stock has a consensus rating of “Buy” and a consensus price target of $204.00.
Apple Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers to consumers, and small and mid-sized businesses; and education, enterprise, and government customers worldwide. The company also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications.
